Delhi Police Accused of Harassing Protesters at Jantar Mantar

Protesters at Delhi's Jantar Mantar reported being subjected to a "cat and mouse" game by the Delhi Police, according to one account. The reporting suggests the police engaged in actions that hindered the protesters' activities. Another report questions the effectiveness of the Delhi Police at the Jantar Mantar protest site.
